evidence: A LIVE GAMEPLAY DEFECT, not the display counter this note calls it, and nobody took the ownership it hands off. player.upkeep.totalWeight is set to 0 once (game/gear.ts:1284) and thereafter mutated ONLY by the wizard quantity editor (game/wizard.ts:1470-1471). Nothing sums the gear: calc_inventory's weight accumulation is absent from the port entirely, and there is no other writer anywhere in packages/core or packages/web. Three live consequences. (1) player/calcs.ts:1215-1220, the carrying-weight speed penalty (calc_bonuses 2222-2230): j is always 0, so j > limit/2 never holds and the player moves at full speed under any load - weight management, a core mechanic, does not exist. (2) combat/melee.ts:617, shield-bash quality is short by trunc(totalWeight/80) on every bash (fed from game/player-turn.ts:235). (3) The character sheet's Burden line always prints 0.0 lb (game/char-sheet.ts:411) and weightRemaining reports the full capacity as free (web/src/screens.ts:491)
text: The running carried-weight total (p->upkeep->total_weight beyond the reset to 0); recomputing it belongs to the calc/inventory owner.
